create_LostAndFoundConfig: create a LostAndFoundConfig builder config with right_images, segmentation_labels, instance_ids, disparity_maps, and use_16bit options
build_Builder_dataset: build a GeneratorBasedBuilder for the Lost and Found road hazard dataset with semantic segmentation, stereo disparity, and full configurations
run_Builder_info: run the Builder _info method to get dataset features including image_left, image_right, segmentation_label, instance_id, disparity_map, and image_id
run_Builder_splits: run the Builder _split_generators method to download and extract train and test splits from zip archives
summarize__get_id_from_left_image: summarize the _get_id_from_left_image helper function that extracts image id from left image filenames using regex
